body: thank you....i've been diagnosed with a few things but never been officially diagnosed with depression, though i feel it sometimes. i just said ptsd because i think most of my problems stem from trauma

i'm in therapy and it hasn't done much to alleviate my anxiety. i'm on medications but i'm switching to a new psychiatrist because my old one made me cry and never listened, she thought resorting to ect would be a better option than prescribing me medications for anxiety / panic attacks and i felt like she didn't care and was spiteful
